cause_quote: The introducing diff mapped `limit_reached` to “This claw has reached its limit for people or devices. Remove one to add another.”
user_saw: When an invitation hit its limit, Remote access incorrectly told the owner to remove a person or device.
summary: The fix tells owners to review the error details for the applicable access limit and keeps the specific reason available in Technical details.
reasoning: The Access page’s introducing diff routes invitation-registration errors through the new mapper and displays its message. The parent commit’s invitation-registration code already returned `limit_reached` at the invitation cap, so the page gave misleading guidance from its first version.
